description: Use when a customer has already realized value and the rep or customer-success lead needs to generate new leads by asking that satisfied customer for referrals — whom and when to ask, the ask scripts, orchestrating the intro (forwardable, group chat, name permission), and tracking/rewarding the loop. Triggers: '转介绍', '要转介绍', 'referral', 'warm intro', 'ask for referral', '推荐线索', '熟人介绍'. Do NOT use for testimonials/case studies (success-advocacy-management), qualifying referred leads (prospect bucket), or renewal/expansion.
